definitions.explanation: Without covering or protection; figuratively, without pretense.

examples.japanese: {赤|あか}ちゃんが{裸|はだか}で{遊|あそ}んでいる。
お{風呂|ふろ}に{入|はい}るために{裸|はだか}になった。
examples.english: I undressed to take a bath.
examples.notes: {裸|はだか}になる = to undress, to get naked

examples.japanese: {温泉|おんせん}では{知|し}らない{人|ひと}と{裸|はだか}で{一緒|いっしょ}にお{湯|ゆ}に{入|はい}る。
examples.english: At hot springs, you bathe naked together with strangers.

examples.japanese: {裸|はだか}の{付|つ}き{合|あ}いで{友情|ゆうじょう}を{深|ふか}めた。
examples.english: We deepened our friendship through frank, open interaction.
examples.notes: {裸|はだか}の{付|つ}き{合|あ}い = honest, open relationship (lit. 'naked association')

examples.japanese: {裸|はだか}の{木|き}が{冬|ふゆ}の{空|そら}に{立|た}っている。
examples.english: Bare trees stand against the winter sky.

examples.japanese: {裸電球|はだかでんきゅう}が{一|ひと}つだけぶら{下|さ}がっている{部屋|へや}だった。
examples.english: It was a room with only a single bare light bulb hanging.
examples.notes: {裸電球|はだかでんきゅう} = bare/unshaded light bulb

notes:
Can be used literally (without clothes) or figuratively (exposed, honest, bare).

COMMON EXPRESSIONS:
・{裸|はだか}になる (to become naked, to strip down)
・{裸|はだか}の{付|つ}き{合|あ}い (frank, heart-to-heart relationship)
・{裸一貫|はだかいっかん} (starting with nothing but oneself)
・{裸|はだか}の{王様|おうさま} (The Emperor's New Clothes)

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
・{裸足|はだし} (barefoot)
・{裸眼|らがん} (naked eye, without glasses)
・{素裸|すっぱだか} (stark naked - emphatic)
